documents.title: UCB announces US FDA approval of RYSTIGGO (rozanolixizumab-noli) for adults with generalized myasthenia gravis
documents.text: [UCB] today announced RYSTIGGO® (rozanolixizumab-noli)* has been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) […] [rozanolixizumab-noli] binds to the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRN), resulting in the reduction of circulating IgG […] It has been designed to block the interaction of FcRn and Immunoglobulin G (IgG).
